newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down ahead of PORLA data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down ahead of PORLA data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Dec (3rd pos) 1,133 rgt/tonne Oct (south) 1,170
Open/Hi/low 1,132/1,137/1,125 Prev close 1,175
Prev settlement 1,157 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - A bearish USDA report weakened the market generally and prices closed with sharp falls. Crop forecaster Ivan Wong report has no impact on the market which is awaiting key PORLA September data on Tuesday. Some switching of November to January position was seen.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Lack of export business also prompted players to sell.
"Ivan Wong data today has no impact on the market as figures were within market expectations," a dealer said.
Wong said palm oil output in September is estimated to have risen by 3.4 percent to 838,000 tonnes over August.
Palm oil stocks at end-September are estimated at 900,000 tonnes, against 800,893 tonnes at end-August.

Plantation houses said on Monday that Malaysian palm oil output in September is estimated to range between a fall of three percent to a rise of four percent over the August production of 810,550 tonnes.
"Production for September was down marginally because there was a rise in August. So the trees are taking a rest in September," an official of a plantation firm said.
"Now we have to wait for PORLA. It may give some surprises like last month," said another trader.
Trading on the futures market was active with volume rising to 1,990 lots from the year's low of 327 lots on Friday.

Technical selling also emerged when December futures broke the support level of 1,130 ringgit. At the close, the contract fell 24 ringgit to 1,133 ringgit ($452.48) a tonne after trading between 1,125 and 1,137 ringgit.
The next support level is seen at 1,110 ringgit. "And if 1,110 is broken, then we will see December futures fall to below 1,100 level," a dealer said.
Physicals Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,170 ringgit a tonne with bids at 1,165. Oct (central) was offered at 1,150 with bids at 1,145 and Oct (north) at 1,140 against 1,120.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,180 ringgit with bids at 1,170. Nov (central) saw offers at 1,160 and bids at 1,150 and Dec (south) at 1,180 with bids at 1,170.
In refined palm oil market, Oct RBD palm oil was offered at $500 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Nov/Dec at $495 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $497.50.
Oct palm olein saw offers at $535, Nov at $527.50, Dec at $525 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $527.50. Nov was traded at $525 and Dec at $522.50.
Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $377.50 and Nov at $382.50. Oct/Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $327.50. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5040 ringgit)
